title: Implement jmap-client crate
description: Implement the RFC 8620 base JMAP client crate. Extracts auth, transport, session fetch, JmapRequestBuilder, blob, SSE, and WebSocket from crate-jmapchat-client and generalizes them. Once complete, jmap-chat-client and jmap-mail-client depend on this instead of duplicating the infrastructure. See crate-jmap-client/PLAN.md.
